Big first step

From free reel to $497 with nothing between

Someone who loves your reels today can join your newsletter or book a $497 session. There's no low-cost way to feel your work first, so most do neither.

Applications

Your forms only work for people already sold

You already filter with applications, which is great. But nothing teaches a stranger what somatic leadership work is before they meet the form, so the form only catches people who already know you.

Reach

New people arrive when you post

8,979 posts, 3 in the last week, reels averaging 1.6k views. That reach is real, but it rises and falls with how much you show up, and retreat seats need filling months ahead.

The leaders not ready for 1:1 or a retreat today leave without a next step built for them, and you can't see who is ready.

My recommendation

A $17 masterclass that becomes the front door to everything you offer

You don't have a low-cost product of your own yet, so the class itself is the first purchase: $17 for a live hour with you. A small kit is offered on the thank-you page, and the replay page is where the right people apply for Journey or a retreat. Your podcast, book and newsletter stay exactly as they are.

Who this class is for

Leaders who are ready to drop the mask

  • Founders and executives who feel like they're playing a role at work.
  • Coaches and guides who give everything to clients and keep little for themselves.
  • Leaders who want their presence to carry the room, not their effort.
  • Anyone curious how body awareness changes the way they lead.

Here's what you'll learn

Five things we'll cover in 60 minutes

Where the mask comes from

How capable people learn to perform strength instead of feeling it, and how to notice it in your own day.

What your body knows first

How to read the signals your body sends before a hard conversation, a pitch or a big decision.

A 90-second grounding practice

A simple somatic practice to come back to yourself before you walk into any room. We'll do it together, live.

What the herd teaches about presence

Lessons from Equìa: why horses respond to who you are, not who you pretend to be, and what that means for leaders.

Your first step this week

One practice to begin straight after the class, so the shift lasts longer than the hour.

Before you get your seat

Why is it $17 and not free?

Because people who invest a little show up and take part. The $17 keeps the room small enough for real Q&A.

What if I can't make it live?

Register anyway. The replay is available for 72 hours after the class.

Is this therapy?

No. It's an educational coaching class. It isn't therapy or medical care and doesn't replace working with a licensed professional.

Do I need to turn my camera on?

No. You can follow the practice quietly, and share in the chat if you'd like to.

Script 1 · "The herd"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"My horses have never once been impressed by a job title."

Body

"Horses respond to what's real in you, not the version you perform. Walk into the herd tense and pretending you're fine, and they feel it. Leaders work the same way. People feel the mask before they hear the words."

CTA

"I'm teaching what the herd taught me in a live 60-minute masterclass, Lead Without the Mask. It's $17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up."

Shot: Ruby in the paddock with two horses, mountains behind, talking to camera.

Script 2 · "90 seconds"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"What do you do in the 90 seconds before a hard conversation?"

Body

"Most leaders rehearse the words. Very few check in with their body. Yet that's what the other person reads first. There's a simple grounding practice I teach every leader I work with, and it takes about 90 seconds."

CTA

"I'll guide you through it live in my masterclass. Tap Sign up to get your seat."

Shot: Ruby seated, slows down, breathes, talks to camera. On-screen text "90 seconds".

Script 3 · "Performing strength"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Capable people often learn to perform strength instead of feeling it."

Body

"It works for a while. You hold it together, you get results. But sincerity is what people follow. For 12+ years I've helped leaders drop the act and lead from who they really are. It starts in the body."

CTA

"Join me for Lead Without the Mask, live, 60 minutes, $17. Tap Sign up below."

Shot: talking to camera outdoors, cut to mountain and herd b-roll (no other faces).
